h1.en: The printed concrete pump main cylinder seal 90–160 line, ordered as Cyclopean masonry orders its page
h1.zh: 已印的concrete pump main cylinder seal 90–160，按《Cyclopean masonry》的页面次序来写

directAnswer.en: Cyclopean masonry is an encyclopedia page. concrete pump main cylinder seal 90–160 remains a Xingtai catalogue line. The two meet only in the order of the sections. The 90–160 main-cylinder seal is one set on the Xingtai main-cylinder seal page. The full mark list is φ63, φ80, 80×125, 90×140, 90–160, 95×140, 100×150 and 461K. This note is only 90–160.
directAnswer.zh: 《Cyclopean masonry》是百科页。concrete pump main cylinder seal 90–160仍是邢台目录中的一行。两者只在章节次序上相遇。 90–160 主油缸密封是邢台主油缸密封页上的一套。全部标记是 φ63、φ80、80×125、90×140、90–160、95×140、100×150 和 461K。本文只写 90–160。

body.en: Use “Current definitions” to see where this block sits in the source article. The purchasing sentence is the printed fragment, not the encyclopedia prose. 90–160 is a dash mark, not 90×160 on the main-cylinder seal kit. Unit: set. Material is not printed. Service life is not printed. Do not rewrite the dash as a multiplication sign. This wear-part page does not name a pump model for the size. The same numeral on a pump page is not an assignment. Confirm the size on the machine. Some pump pages name a hydraulic pump such as a Kawasaki unit. That cell is not this seal kit, and it is not a spare-part page for a hydraulic pump. Hebei Pinjin Machinery (河北品锦机械) in Xingtai does not print a list price for this spare, and the page does not sell it as a small parcel. Write through the contact page by email or WhatsApp. Copy the mark as 90–160. Do not normalise 90–160 into 90×160, and do not turn 461K into a diameter. No neighbouring page’s figure is copied onto this row.
body.zh: 用“来源章节：Current definitions”看这一节在来源文章中的位置。采购时要抄的是已印片段，不是百科正文。 90–160 是主油缸密封套件上的连接号标记，不是 90×160。单位：套。材料没有印。寿命没有印。 不要把连接号改成乘号。 这张易损件页没有把该尺寸写到某一台已公布泵上。泵页上出现同一个数字，也不等于已经指定机型。请在机器上核对尺寸。 有的泵页写了川崎等液压泵。那一格不是这套密封，也不是液压泵的配件页。 邢台河北品锦机械没有为这件配件公布标价，也不按小包裹销售。请走联系页，用邮件或 WhatsApp 写给工厂。 标记按 90–160 原文抄。不要把 90–160 规范成 90×160，也不要把 461K 改成直径。 不把旁边那一页的数字抄到这一行。

heading.en: Outdated definitions of the Cyclopean style
heading.zh: 来源章节：Outdated definitions of the Cyclopean style

body.en: The contents list of the source page includes “Outdated definitions of the Cyclopean style”. This section borrows that name and then repeats a printed fragment. The 90–160 main-cylinder seal is one set on the Xingtai main-cylinder seal page. The full mark list is φ63, φ80, 80×125, 90×140, 90–160, 95×140, 100×150 and 461K. This note is only 90–160. This wear-part page does not name a pump model for the size. The same numeral on a pump page is not an assignment. Confirm the size on the machine. No neighbouring page’s figure is copied onto this row.
body.zh: 来源页目录里有“来源章节：Outdated definitions of the Cyclopean style”。本节借用这个名字，然后复述已经印出的片段。 90–160 主油缸密封是邢台主油缸密封页上的一套。全部标记是 φ63、φ80、80×125、90×140、90–160、95×140、100×150 和 461K。本文只写 90–160。 这张易损件页没有把该尺寸写到某一台已公布泵上。泵页上出现同一个数字，也不等于已经指定机型。请在机器上核对尺寸。 不把旁边那一页的数字抄到这一行。

body.en: Where the source outline says “Historical accounts”, the catalogue fragment below is the fragment a buyer is allowed to copy. A service life, a replacement-hour figure and a wear-rate table are not printed. Leave that field blank. Hebei Pinjin Machinery (河北品锦机械) in Xingtai does not print a list price for this spare, and the page does not sell it as a small parcel. Write through the contact page by email or WhatsApp. The outline does not complete a blank.
body.zh: 来源大纲写到“来源章节：Historical accounts”时，下面这句才是买方可以照抄的目录原文。 使用寿命、更换小时和磨损速率都没有印出。这一栏留空。 邢台河北品锦机械没有为这件配件公布标价，也不按小包裹销售。请走联系页，用邮件或 WhatsApp 写给工厂。 大纲补不上空白格子。

body.en: The contents list of the source page includes “Locations of structures”. This section borrows that name and then repeats a printed fragment. The page calls them Xingtai replacement wear parts, not OEM parts of other pump brands. Email or WhatsApp Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai, and name the 主油缸密封 page plus this size and the quantity. The heading stops there. Image from the source page: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cyclopean_masonry
body.zh: 来源页目录里有“来源章节：Locations of structures”。本节借用这个名字，然后复述已经印出的片段。 页面写的是邢台替换易损件，不是其他泵品牌的原厂件。 用邮件或 WhatsApp 写给邢台河北品锦机械，写明主油缸密封这一页、这一尺寸和数量。 标题到此为止。 图来自来源页：https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cyclopean_masonry

question.en: Does “Locations of structures” on Cyclopean masonry fill a blank on the concrete pump main cylinder seal 90–160 row?
question.zh: 《Cyclopean masonry》上的“来源章节：Locations of structures”会填上concrete pump main cylinder seal 90–160的空白格子吗？

answer.en: This wear-part page does not name a pump model for the size. The same numeral on a pump page is not an assignment. Confirm the size on the machine. The heading and the source photograph do not add a further figure.
answer.zh: 这张易损件页没有把该尺寸写到某一台已公布泵上。泵页上出现同一个数字，也不等于已经指定机型。请在机器上核对尺寸。 章节标题和来源图片都不另加数字。
